crossRefs.note: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;
Yahweh’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah…
Now Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
Yahweh’s word that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw…
Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was…
Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

parallels.note: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

people.name: Amon
people.line: King of Judah, son of Manasseh

people.name: Josiah
people.line: King of Judah known for his religious reforms

translations.web: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
translations.bsb: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,
translations.kjv: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
translations.asv: to whom the word of Jehovah came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
